precedence.select_when: Any hard isolation, authorization, readiness, cleanup, durable-restart, or immutable-versus-mutable reuse gate fails.
precedence.decision: Stop or narrow the service lifecycle claim before production work.

precedence.select_when: Every hard gate passes and one manager-owned transport-neutral routing mechanism serves both target classes without project-visible provider data or a provider route capability.
precedence.decision: Recommend experimental Service, Endpoint, and Stack concepts after the daemon foundation; no API stabilizes here.

precedence.select_when: Typed handles, authorization, lifecycle, and every hard gate pass, but fake-macOS connectivity requires one declared provider route capability hidden behind the target adapter.
precedence.decision: Retain typed endpoints and make cross-target routing an explicit typed provider capability.

precedence.select_when: Native lifecycle is rejected and a separately approved, actually reachable Compose candidate passes the identical isolation, authorization, readiness, cleanup, reuse, and overhead gates.
precedence.decision: Place Compose-style lifecycle behind one typed service leaf before attempting native lifecycle ownership.

precedence.select_when: No earlier branch is eligible, including when Compose is unavailable or unapproved.
precedence.decision: Narrow Taskflow to typed references to externally managed services or stop the full-stack claim.
